clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, an Encrypted Scroll calls a newly risen rogue to training. Sealed by David Trias, it directs its bearer to meet him at the inn and begin training among the Forsaken’s covert operatives.

In Deathknell, a newly awakened Forsaken with a gift for stealth draws notice. The Encrypted Scroll is handed over after a scout proves capable against the mindless Scourge in the nearby graveyard. Sealed by rogue trainer David Trias, it tells the bearer to find him at the local inn. The summons points a fledgling operative toward the discipline needed to serve the Dark Lady, rather than spend a second chance at life as a pickpocket.

The scroll’s brief message tells the rogue to make contact in Deathknell before traveling deeper into Tirisfal Glades. Trias watches for promising talent on behalf of the Shadowstalkers, the Forsaken’s covert arm. In Lordaeron, the Forsaken rely on silent blades and cunning scouts against the Scarlet Crusade, surviving Alliance enclaves, and the Scourge left behind. Answering the ciphered summons begins the path toward joining that covert network.
